context:
Goal: lanes keep moving without wasting your attention.
Problem (goal): today the whole team runs on the Mac, so lanes stop when the Mac sleeps. Cloud lanes would keep running, but they report only by pull request.
Based on (ruling): your ruling of 2026-11-04 07:56 CST, lanes-start-as-agents: one placement for the whole team.
Based on (read): plan cloud-sessions, section Decisions for the owner.
Departs from: lanes-start-as-agents puts the whole team in one place — option b moves the lanes to the cloud and keeps the coordinator on the Mac.
Unvetted: the past-ruling check timed out.

title: Keep the whole mailaudit team on the Mac, or run the lanes in the cloud?
why: Most lanes need the simulator, which runs only on the Mac, and it keeps your one-placement ruling.
